import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(99)
k = rng.integers(0, 5, 12000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (5, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (12000, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['group'] = pd.Categorical(['Aries', 'Taurus', 'Gemini', 'Cancer', 'Leo'][v] for v in k)
df.shape

steps.name: open annotate tab and enable automatic clusters
steps.eval: document.querySelector('#tab-annotate').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Label by"]'); sel.value = 'clusters'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))
steps.report: { clusterCount: a.clusterCount, labelCount: a.labelCount, fittedZoom: a.fittedZoom }

steps.name: enable two levels of detail (A8 multi-level)
fine clusters are computed
steps.report: { hasFineClusters: a.clusterFine !== null, fineK: a.clusterFine?.k, coarseK: a.clusterCount, fittedZoom: a.fittedZoom }

steps.name: AT OVERVIEW ZOOM: only coarse labels are drawn (fine alpha=0)
steps.eval: const fz = a.fittedZoom; const vs = a.renderer['viewState']; window.__overviewTarget = vs.target; a.renderer['viewState'] = { ...vs, zoom: fz, target: vs.target }; a.renderer['deck'].setProps({ viewState: a.renderer['viewState'] }); a.renderer['viewChangeCallback']?.(fz); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600))
steps.report: { zoom: a.renderer['viewState'].zoom, fittedZoom: a.fittedZoom, labelCount: a.renderer.labels.length, coarseOnly: a.renderer.labels.length === a.clusterCount }

steps.name: overview export: count non-black pixels (coarse labels only)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] + d[i+1] + d[i+2] > 60) n++; window.__overviewPixels = n

steps.name: ZOOM IN past threshold (fittedZoom+1.5): fine labels appear
steps.eval: const fz = a.fittedZoom; const newZoom = fz + 1.8; const vs = a.renderer['viewState']; const firstLabel = a.renderer.labels[0]; const target = firstLabel ? [firstLabel.position[0], firstLabel.position[1], 0] : vs.target; a.renderer['viewState'] = { ...vs, zoom: newZoom, target }; a.renderer['deck'].setProps({ viewState: a.renderer['viewState'] }); a.renderer['viewChangeCallback']?.(newZoom); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000))
steps.report: { zoom: a.renderer['viewState'].zoom, labelCount: a.renderer.labels.length, coarseCount: a.clusterCount, fineCount: a.clusterFine?.k }

steps.name: zoomed-in export: labels are visible (pixels present)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] + d[i+1] + d[i+2] > 60) n++; window.__zoomedPixels = n
steps.report: { zoomedPixels: window.__zoomedPixels, labelCount: a.renderer.labels.length, coarseCount: a.clusterCount, fineCount: a.clusterFine?.k }

steps.name: zoom back to overview: fine labels disappear
steps.eval: const fz = a.fittedZoom; const vs = a.renderer['viewState']; const ovrTarget = window.__overviewTarget ?? vs.target; a.renderer['viewState'] = { ...vs, zoom: fz, target: ovrTarget }; a.renderer['deck'].setProps({ viewState: a.renderer['viewState'] }); a.renderer['viewChangeCallback']?.(fz); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600))

steps.name: zoom in again and verify collision priorities: coarse always beats fine
steps.eval: const fz = a.fittedZoom; const newZoom = fz + 2; const vs = a.renderer['viewState']; const firstLabel = a.renderer.labels[0]; const target = firstLabel ? [firstLabel.position[0], firstLabel.position[1], 0] : vs.target; a.renderer['viewState'] = { ...vs, zoom: newZoom, target }; a.renderer['deck'].setProps({ viewState: a.renderer['viewState'] }); a.renderer['viewChangeCallback']?.(newZoom); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); const coarseLabels = a.renderer.labels.filter((l, i) => i < a.clusterCount); const fineLabels = a.renderer.labels.filter((l, i) => i >= a.clusterCount); const minCoarse = coarseLabels.length ? Math.min(...coarseLabels.map(l => l.priority ?? 0)) : 0; const maxFine = fineLabels.length ? Math.max(...fineLabels.map(l => l.priority ?? 0)) : -Infinity; window.__priorityOk = coarseLabels.length > 0 && fineLabels.length > 0 && minCoarse > maxFine
steps.report: { priorityOk: window.__priorityOk, coarseCount: a.clusterCount, fineCount: a.clusterFine?.k, totalLabels: a.renderer.labels.length }
